sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub Trending list. Google/ax is the clear momentum leader at +2,324 stars, while the rest of the leading set clusters around agent runtimes, tool registries, agent-ready office software, and coding-agent media workflows.

sections.title: mvt-project/mvt
sections.description: Mobile forensics tooling for finding signs of device compromise.

sections.title: anthropics/financial-services
sections.description: An Anthropic project for financial-services use cases.

sections.title: dream-num/univer
sections.description: An office harness for AI agents spanning spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvas, relational tables, and PDF.

sections.title: superdesigndev/treg
sections.description: An OpenRouter-like layer for agent tools.

sections.title: davila7/claude-code-templates
sections.description: A CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent runtimes and substrates, agent tooling and operations, agents in work applications, Python-led applied automation, and domain-specific security/financial systems.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The strongest shift is from standalone model demos toward operational agent stacks: orchestration runtimes, substrates, tool registries, configuration, and agent-mediated work applications.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub momentum is accruing around the connective tissue that makes agents useful in real workflows, not only around models themselves. Go is gaining visibility in foundational runtimes, while Python remains the main implementation language for applied tools and automation.
